title: CONTAINMENT FIELD
text: Secret: After the next enemy Character is played, Paralyse it for two turns.

title: OPEN MANHOLE
text: Secret: Before the next enemy attacker deals combat damage, return it to its owner's hand.

title: PLASMA MINE
text: Secret: When an enemy attacks an allied Character, deal 4 damage to the attacker before combat.

title: SMOKE BOMB
text: Secret: When an enemy attacks an allied Character, cancel the attack. That Character gains Stealth until your next turn.

title: WET CEMENT
text: Secret: When an enemy attacks an allied Character, the attacker gets -4 Attack until your next turn.
